verdict.rationale: Kushki is an API-first payments platform, so it can be driven headlessly. Its own docs cover server-side flows such as direct charges without a token, 100% API 3DS integration, and authorization/capture and refunds via API, plus a test data and sandbox path that automated pipelines could run against. However, there is no CLI or documented CI workflow, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404). Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless tooling, a documented CI/test-mode automation guide, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
